notes.title: Critical project change
notes.content:
Hexagold project development stop
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550067/8101bba065750d32a29d0621f79f58adf4e9399f.png

Hello there. I spend some time to try manage my Hexagold ideas for a long time, maybe 2-3 years. I would finish my initial idea, but now I'm stuck with it. Working solo on projects like that require a lot of extra energy to put inside. Also need always to learn new technical stuff to gain progress.

Now I feel there is no point to continue with the same approach, I really should change my plan and scope of features, I should focus more on gamedesign.

So, right now I decided to pause Hexagold project. It's not cancelled, but right now I have not enough confidence I spending my time properly, I need to restart this project later when I become more skilled and be able to manage development process.


Back to my passion physics project
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44550067/87e13e8ed2d3e19cf042c6ccaa6e9b74f632496c.png

Probably you saw some strange screenshots with sphere and colored cubes. It's not a bug, this is one of my fist pet projects from times when I just started to learn Unity and programming.

I decided to breathe new life into it. Frankly, I really love physics games with gravity. 

Please watch these videos. They can help you understand main idea:
https://youtu.be/iY5FgRYcGWI
https://youtu.be/e3wHuFS4TZs
https://youtu.be/mo_ocbOHi00
https://youtu.be/DeQwfM8dFOs
Full Youtube Playlist


What my plans on this Gravity project?
So, I have some cool ideas and I believe I have enough skills to implement them. I already spend dozens of hours to play my Gravity game, it's just make me feel good when I playing. I hope you will love it too.

General feature list at the moment:
[olist]
 PLAYER: control physical entity (ball) with cool gravity abilities. Need to survive in the arena with different dangers.
 ENVIRONMENT: dynamic environment with hundreds/thousands of dynamic objects to play with.
 OBSTACLES: different destroyable interactive structures like buttons, gates, brick walls, heavy debris, decorative objects.
 ENEMIES: some nasty enemies with gravity abilities to chase player and try to destroy. Some enemies can change physics behavior and impact player's trajectory.
 ABILITIES: more diverse physics abilities like a gravity shield, tornado, zero gravity field, gravity traps, orbital gravity and more.
 LEVELING: kind of progression. Player gain some experience points and spend them to increase some parameters like mass, max energy, health, regeneration, gravity force and etc.
 REPLAYABILITY: roguelike approach. Game session will be different each time, progression, enemies, game flow can be randomized and generated each session.
 TARGET PLATFORMS: now I'm focused to run smooth on Steam Deck and PC. It already works really well, thanks to my old prototypes. Now I will stick only with these platforms and will think about something else in future, if project will be in good condition and I will not stuck again.
[/olist]
I really want to make this game as a toy, all you need to just play and get fun. No complex rules, story, dialogs, just a pure gameplay with a lot of chaos and destroy.

Join Discord Community
We can discuss anything you want regarding Gravity game and other gamedev stuff. I always opened for feedback. I usually post some latest updates to my Discord and Youtube, so it will be easier to reach me out there.

I love this game and will try to do my best to bring it to you soon. I hope you will like it too.
Cheers

notes.title: Version 0.0.28 important changes
notes.content:
Features

 added radial menu for transferring gold with throw count/percentage options
 added building info pop-up with a cost and "build progress ratio" status
 added gold collection by units when moving
 added gold throwing onto other tiles via radial menu
 added gold transfer skill to fill target gold limit
 added gold limit for units and buildings
 added gold balance for units and buildings in HUD
 added tile visibility check before throwing gold
 added logic for creating units around the building
 added healing mechanics
 added some skills placeholders to radial menu. Low transparent skills not yet implemented

Changes

 changed the move cancellation logic. Simply select a Unit and press A on it.
 disable the radial menu when building a plan
 changed the radial position from the center to the left side
 changed the transparency of the radial menu
 removed "Shift Object Group" button and added holding LB, RB to Shift object groups


This is the big update with a lot of small changes. Most important one is gold mechanics. Now there is a lot of interactions with gold coins between units and buildings. Every unit has his own gold pockets with limit and you need to manually manage this gold.

For example, you wish to build barracks and then build units from it. So, you put a building plan somewhere and add gold cost in this plan. When you fill building plan with gold, it starts building process and after some time building will be finished.

Then you want to recruit some units, so just put some gold inside the building and this allow to buy some units for this gold.

Some units have skills which costs golds or action points. So, for use these skills unit must have some gold in pockets.

This mechanics may looks weird, but it's ok, just need to complete this idea and add more balance.
Also I want that player starts with manual gold managing and gradually becomes to automatic gold managing. I have some ideas, but need time to achieve that.

Every tile make sense and it's not just a visual asset. Each type of tile will affect to area around and give special bonuses, so keeping some special tiles near your base will be a good decision to rise economics and defenses.
